fallback_rule.citation: KSK Reader VI: Horary Astrology, PDF p.286 — 'The planets in 11th bhava and its owner indicate whether one's desire will be fulfilled early or not.'; KP Year Book 2010, PDF p.53 — 'The 11th cusp decides the overall fructification of the desire of the querist.'
fallback_rule.description: For jobs with no book-cited mapping: judge the 11th cuspal sub-lord and the 11th lord. Promise = 11th CSL signifies 11th (fulfillment of desire) together with the job array 2-6-10; denial = 11th CSL signifies 5, 8, 12.

accountant.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.146 (Gemini: 'Book-keepers, accountants, clerks… cashiers'); Astro Secrets & KP Part 1 (Shanmugam), PDF p.349 (Mercury → Tax Collector, Tax Officer, Revenue Dept).

army.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.374 — 'one will be employed in the military department'; K.P. Astro for Beginners Vol 3 (K. Subramaniam), PDF p.93 — 'good to take up service in the Defence Department'.

astrologer.citation: Easy Way to Learn KP Horary Astrology (Kanak Bosmia), PDF p.346 — worked case: 10th CSL Venus signifies 10-2-9-11-12-4-7 → 'successful in astrology and earn from astrology for sure'; outcome verified.

banker.citation: Astro Secrets & KP Part 1 (M.P. Shanmugam), PDF p.350 — 'If the 10th Sub lord is Jupiter and connected to 6th House… he will serve as… Service in Bank, Cashier…'.

civil_service_exam.citation: KP Ezine Issue 191 (Dec 2022), PDF p.1 — worked case: 4th CSL significator of 4,9,11,6 → success in Civil Service / Group I exams; native selected to IPS cadre 2019 (outcome verified).
civil_service_exam.display: Civil service / competitive exam (IAS/IPS/IFS entry via exam)

doctor.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF pp.351-353 — Sun = medicine; Sun+Jupiter → physicians; Sun+Mars → able surgeons; Sun+Venus+Jupiter → maternity specialisation; Astro Secrets & KP Part 1, PDF p.349 — 10th SL Mars + 7th connection → 'Doctors, Medical shop'.

factory_worker.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.439 — 'Profession: Dealers in lead, iron… quarry, metals, mine ores'; Astro Secrets & KP Part 1, PDF p.350 — 10th SL Saturn + 6th → iron factories, forest, vehicle repair, roads, cement factories.

government_job.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF pp.350-351 — 'Sun generally indicates a permanent position in life. All government services and those in such departments where there is security of service are denoted by Sun.'; KSK Reader VI: Horary Astrology, PDF p.286 — worked horary 'When will I get a job?': significators of 2,6,10 × ruling planets give the job in their joint period.

lawyer.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.353 — 'Jupiter with Sun and Mercury indicates civil laws, whereas Mars indicate Criminal Law.'

mechanical_engineer.citation: KSK Reader VI: Horary Astrology, PDF p.286 — worked case: 10th cusp (Mercury sign / Mars star / Sun sub) → 'Mechanical Engineer in Government'; 'Sun indicates Government, Mars and Mercury indicate Mechanical Engineering.' Prediction fulfilled.

musician.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.414 — 'Profession: Musicians… cinema actors, actress, film producers…'; Astro Secrets & KP Part 1, PDF p.350 — 10th SL Venus + 6th → 'Cinema Theatre'; + 7th → 'Actor, Music'.

police.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.374 — 'Police is also governed by Mars'; Astro Secrets & KP Part 1 (Shanmugam), PDF p.349 — 'if the 10th Sub lord is Mars and if connected to 6th House One's profession will be by Service in Police, Military…'.

teacher.citation: Astro Secrets & KP Part 1 (M.P. Shanmugam), PDF pp.349-350 — 'If the 10th Sub lord is MERCURY and connected to 6th House… he will serve in a… Teacher…'; 'If the 10th Sub lord is Jupiter… he will serve as Professor, Lecturer, Higher Education…'.

transport_driver.citation: KSK Reader II, PDF p.414 — Venus → 'transport, automobile railway, bus, taxi, lorry, air travel, shipping'; Astro Secrets & KP Part 1, PDF p.350 — 10th SL Venus + 6th → 'Transport'.
